### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A20, A21, A30, A31 and A32 formed a mandatory middle segment: each ran in all 200 traces, sitting around position 0.38–0.39 of the trace between the A14→A15→A16 run and A33. In the later window they have practically disappeared — A20 and A21 in 0 of 200 traces, A30, A31 and A32 in only 1–2 of 200. [OCC006, OCC007, OCC012, OCC013, OCC014, POS005, POS006, POS010, POS011, POS012]
- Five activities that did not occur earlier now run in about 16–24 in 100 later traces (32–47 of 200): A19, A22, A23, A24 and A25, all clustered around position 0.36–0.39 — the region A20 and A21 used to occupy. [OCC005, OCC008, OCC009, OCC010, OCC011, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009]
- The new activities flow into A33: about 95–98 in 100 of the observed outgoing transitions of A19, A22, A23 and A24 go to A33, and A14 or A15 now precede A22–A24 in about 21–24 in 100 traces, where these pairs never co-occurred before. [DIR005, DIR008, DIR009, DIR010, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL027, REL028, REL029, REL071, REL080, REL088]
- A04 fell from about 76 in 100 traces to about 20 in 100 (152 → 39 of 200); earlier, about 96 in 100 of its observed outgoing transitions went to A20/A21/A30/A31/A32, while later they go mainly to A54, A16, A15, A23 and A52; when A04 does occur, it sits much later in the trace (upper quartile 0.34 → 0.86, by event position). [OCC001, DIR001, POS001]
- A48 still runs in every trace, but its outgoing flow moved from mostly A04 (about 72 in 100) to a spread over A22, A23, A24, A19 and A25 (A04 about 4 in 100), and A48 is now followed by A33 within two steps in about 79 in 100 traces, against about 2 in 200 before. [DIR014, LAG010]
- A06, A08 and A10 each run about twice as often as before (participation roughly 8–9 in 100 → 19–21 in 100). [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004]
- A33 remains in every trace but earlier (mean position 0.47 → 0.40); A14→A15 and A15→A16 remain the dominant successors with only small shifts, and A53→A54 stays adjacent. [POS013, DIR003, DIR004, POS002, POS003, LAG011]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis of a structural change: the segment formed by A20, A21, A30, A31 and A32, which was executed in every earlier case between the A14→A15→A16 run and A33, no longer appears in the later window, and a new optional segment — A19 or one of A22, A23, A24, A25 — now runs in about one in five later cases in the same region, each variant flowing into A33. The rewiring around the removed segment is shown directly: A04, which earlier fed almost exclusively into the removed activities, became rare and late, and A48 now typically reaches A33 within about two steps instead of going to A04. This is far beyond what an unchanged process produces: 165 evidence items qualified against about 1.3 expected by chance, and the key shifts run between 200-of-200 and 0-of-200 participation across 200-trace windows. [OCC006, OCC007, OCC012, OCC013, OCC014, OCC005, OCC008, OCC009, OCC010, OCC011, DIR005, DIR008, DIR009, DIR010, DIR001, DIR014, LAG010, REL019, REL027]

The evidence cannot show what now connects the A14→A15→A16 run to A33 in the roughly 80 in 100 later traces without the new activities (A16's outgoing transitions are not covered), and because the new segment appears in only about a fifth of traces, a mixture of two case populations in the later window cannot be ruled out; the 1–2 residual traces containing A30–A32 are too few to characterise. [OCC005, OCC008, OCC009, OCC010, OCC011, OCC012, OCC013, OCC014, DIR004]

Other differences: A06, A08 and A10 participation roughly doubled; A14, A15 and A48 show small shifts to later trace positions; A04's position spread widened markedly in the traces where it still occurs. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, POS002, POS003, POS014, POS001]
